# opnsense_monit_test (Resource)

Monit tests (**Services ▸ Monit ▸ Settings ▸ Service Tests Settings**) are reusable conditions that services refer to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_monit_test" "high_cpu" {
  name      = "HighCPU"
  condition = "cpu usage is greater than 90% for 5 cycles"
  action    = "alert"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Action taken when the condition matches.
- `condition` (String) Monit condition, e.g. `cpu usage is greater than 75%`.
- `name` (String) Name of the test.

### Optional

- `path` (String) Script to run when `action` is `exec`.
- `type` (String) Test type. When unset, OPNsense derives it from `condition` (e.g. `cpu usage …` becomes `SystemResource`); a value that contradicts the condition is replaced by OPNsense.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the Monit test.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_monit_test using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_monit_test.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_monit_test using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_monit_test.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
